rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes. 

Do your children ever make you feel like screaming? 

Give yourself a 10-second pause. Breathe in and out slowly 5 times. 

Then try responding in a calmer way.

Millions of parents say this helps – A LOT.
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.

Adakah anak-anak anda pernah membuat anda rasa seperti mahu menjerit?

Berhentilah seketika selama 10 saat dengan melakukan aktiviti ini. Tarik dan hembus nafas perlahan-lahan sebanyak 5 kali.

Satu..., dua..., tiga..., empat, lima...

Buka semula mata anda perlahan-lahan.

Kemudian cuba memberi respon dengan lebih tenang.

Jutaan ibu bapa mengatakan cara ini sangat membantu mereka. Macam tak percaya kan? Cubalah buat selalu!

📖This skill is about helping your child learn to read. 

2️⃣This skill will take 2 days to complete. 

⭐ Our first lesson today is about enjoying books with your child.

text_2.eng:
The best way to help your child learn to read is to read with them!. 📖🎉

Children learn by watching, listening, and copying. When they are little, they learn new words when you read to them. Later they learn letters and letter sounds, and when they’re bigger, reading together can help them learn about anything they are interested in! 💡

text_1_facilitator.eng:
4️⃣ Here are four ways to help your child learn reading skills: Make Routines ⏰, Ask Questions, Respond and Explore 👀, and Build and Connect 😃

You can also use picture books. Describe what you see and talk about the pictures with your child using language that your child can understand! 💙

rows.text_1_facilitator:
4️⃣ Here are four ways to help your child learn reading skills: Make Routines ⏰, Ask Questions, Respond and Explore 👀, and Build and Connect 😃

You can also use picture books. Describe what you see and talk about the pictures with your child using language that your child can understand! 💙

section_1_text.eng:
📖 You can share books with your child anywhere - in the living room or bedroom, for example! 
Get rid of any distractions (like the TV 📺❌). 
⏰ Pick a time every day when you can share books with your child. 
💡 If your child wants to, let them choose a book 😃
✨ If you don’t have any books - you can use anything with words and pictures, like old magazines or newspapers!

section_2_text.eng:
⭐ From the book cover, ask your child what they think the story might be about. 
➡️ Throughout the book, ask who, what, where, when, why, and how questions.
✨ If you have read a story many times, see if your child knows what comes next! 
👀 Describe what’s happening in a picture. Always use language that your child can understand. 
💡 Ask your child to retell the story.

section_3_text.eng:
👀 Notice what your child is interested in and talk about it. Help them understand the story, words, sounds, letters, and character emotions. 💚
📖 Explore by rephrasing or adding more information - help your child learn new words and understand more 😃
👂 Respond positively and encourage them, even if what they are wrong.
😃 Ask your child to repeat what you have taught them.

section_4_text.eng:
💙 Help your child build confidence by asking questions that they might know the answer to or that encourage them to go a bit further with their skill! 
🎨 Always connect what’s in the book to your child’s experience.
